trello.name: Document prompt injection incident in security log
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Document the support ticket prompt injection attempt properly, including the raw ticket content, what the ticket summarizer actually did (garbled routing summary containing the word URGENT), and timestamps. File it in the security log with a severity assessment. Deadline: this week.

trello.name: Harden ticket summarizer pipeline against prompt injection
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser so quoted customer content is delimited and treated as data when sent to the summarizer, with instruction-like content stripped or neutralized. Turn the exact offending ticket into a regression test fixture that feeds it through and checks the summary stays clean. Also add an eval that runs a small suite of injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy; fold this eval into the same task (approved by Grace). No explicit deadline stated.

trello.name: Investigate jdoe443 account and password reset email delivery
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Check whether jdoe443 is a real account and whether password reset emails are failing to arrive. Check reset email delivery logs for the last week and follow up on the account. If it is a burner account, close it. If resets are actually broken, escalate it as its own incident. No explicit deadline stated.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May for quarterly access review
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Compile and send Grace the list of service accounts created since May, to be used as input for the quarterly access review. Deadline: Thursday.

trello.name: Run quarterly access review
trello.desc: Owner: Grace. Run the quarterly access review, using the list of new service accounts since May provided by Hassan. Deadline: Friday.
